The emissions are net of the stored CO2 from biomass, so the intensity is negative where biomass with carbon capture outweighs the rest. Units making both heat and electricity have their emissions split over the two by their output (Output-Share Split), which sets how much counts here. To aggregate regions, divide the sum of the emissions by that of the electricity; don't sum or average the intensities.
